claim: The original pinned ARM64 parser accepts all 297 shipped csv_logic TOML assets under the explicit bounded runtime models.
scope: Original TOML parsing with a fresh emulator per asset. Nonnull trees and zero error callbacks do not establish fully loaded gameplay data or battle equivalence.

independent_execution.result: All compared fields match; wall-clock timing was not compared. This is repeatability of the same original-parser experiment, not an independent battle oracle or complete parse-tree comparison.

runtime_models: Bounded allocator, memory and ASCII string primitives; exit callbacks are recorded only
Standard next-prime helper restricted to the exercised bounded domain
atof: exact-rational decimal to nearest-even normal binary64, default FPCR only; original Bionic implementation is not executed
Error observer records original messages and returns; unknown formatting imports still stop execution
limitations: Each asset uses a fresh emulator; this does not load all assets into one live data registry.
Original syntax-tree contents are not exhaustively compared; success means a nonnull tree, no native error callbacks and unchanged text.
The shipped duplicate-table character_buffs.toml is accepted unchanged; no replacement TOML grammar is used.
Malformed-input rejection is not established: one private malformed control reaches an unsupported formatting import and stops.
atof uses a bounded exact-rational nearest-even binary64 model; original Bionic execution and complete runtime equivalence remain unverified.
No complete troop, tower, projectile or match equivalence is claimed.
